Express sushi
Feb 2026 • Couples
Very positive to mention is that the quality of the food and the preparation are at the highest level. 

Unfortunately, you don’t get much out of it because you are guided through the menu at a breathtaking pace and in between you hardly have a chance to enjoy the moment. The fact that you are constantly watched by the sushi master in charge of each party is probably a matter of taste. We definitely found it a pity that for a relatively large amount of money all the fun was over in a good 90 minutes. And there was no chance to stretch the matter a bit. 

If each sushi is listed as a separate course, then at the end of many courses there is not too much left.
